D01.label: accurate
D01.note_text: Craig pushed Jamie into a wall in the hall outside the kitchen. Jamie's shoulder hurt when pushed into the wall. The incident when Craig pushed Jamie occurred on a Thursday night, the night before the garden centre.
D01.why: pushed, wall, shoulder, hall, Thursday kept

D02.label: accurate
D02.note_text: Craig kicked Jamie's leg with his foot on the back of his leg. Craig kicked Jamie's leg three times, and said it was 'messing about' or a joke. Jamie felt a bit of pain when kicked and had a bruise.
D02.why: kicked, back of leg, three times, bruise kept; 'joke' attributed to Craig

D03.label: accurate
D03.note_text: Craig told Jamie not to tell anyone about the kicking, saying if Jamie does, he will lose his flat.
